title: ROCOCO: Robust Outline Completion of Occluded Curvilinear Objects
title_zh: ROCOCO：被遮挡曲线目标的鲁棒轮廓补全

paragraphs.en: 提出基于流匹配的ROCOCO模型，在遮挡情况下鲁棒地补全曲线目标轮廓且参数量小。 We propose a learning-based generative model for completing curvilinear features under occlusion by environmental obstacles. To this end, we adopt a flow matching-based approach that supports the inpainting of occluded regions with the appropriate curvilinear features. To eliminate the reliance on privileged information about the occlusion a priori, we also train a UNet-based mask prediction model, which can identify regions for inpainting given only the occluded observation. The components of our approach are validated via experiments using procedurally-generated test cases, and the complete pipeline is validated using large public datasets for curvilinear objects. Against off-the-shelf inpainting baselines, ROCOCO is the strongest method by a wide margin when no occlusion mask is given, and is competitive with mask-supervised inpainting when one is, achieving best on full-image error and second only to LaMa on the occluded region, while using a completer of $7.7$M parameters against LaMa's $51$M and Stable Diffusion's $860$M.
paragraphs.zh: 提出基于流匹配的ROCOCO模型，在遮挡情况下鲁棒地补全曲线目标轮廓且参数量小。我们提出一种基于学习的生成模型，用于在环境障碍物造成遮挡的情况下补全曲线特征。 为此，我们采用基于流匹配的方法，以适当的曲线特征对被遮挡区域进行修复。 为了消除对遮挡先验特权信息的依赖，我们还训练了一个基于UNet的掩码预测模型，在仅有被遮挡观测的情况下即可识别需要修复的区域。 我们通过使用程序化生成的测试用例进行实验来验证本方法的各个组成部分，并使用面向曲线目标的大型公开数据集验证完整流水线。 与现成的修复基线相比，在没有给出遮挡掩码时，ROCOCO以明显优势成为最强的方法；在给出掩码时，其与有掩码监督的修复方法相当，在全图误差上取得最佳，在遮挡区域上仅次于LaMa，同时所用补全器仅有7.7M参数，而LaMa为51M，Stable Diffusion为860M。
